verdict.rationale: Mercury documents its own automatically enforced spend controls: card limits and spend controls to curb team spend, limits and approvals for team expenses, and API management of card spending limits. A long-time customer confirms creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits. However, the evidence only shows per-card limits; nothing documents a department- or program-level budget object that rolls up and enforces spend across cards or users. Missing for 10: documented department/program budget construct, aggregate budget enforcement across multiple cards/users, budget tracking or reporting against limits.
